title: Shrimp Stir Fry with Garlic and Chili Peppers
description: A spicy and savory Chinese-inspired dish made with succulent shrimp, garlic, and chili peppers.

ingredients.name: Spicy Spanish Al Ajillo Chili Peppers

instructions: 1. Marinate the shrimp in Gambas Soy Sauce for 15 minutes.
2. Heat Spanish Olive Oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
4. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the marinated shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
6. Season with salt, black pepper, and Al Chili Flakes to taste.
8. Garnish with sliced green onions and a sprinkle of Al Chili Flakes, if desired.
